page.overview:
Who is Cindy Mackenzie?

Cindy Lee Mackenzie is a major character in Bunny Call, the first story in the book of the same name. She's Bob's sweet young daughter who's high energy and excitement towards Camp Etenia annoys him.

Cindy is pudgy with curly auburn pigtails and freckles.

Cindy is very cute and enthusiastic with tons of energy, getting her family amped up. She is also extra-sensitive and is hard to calm down when upset. Cindy also loves bright and cute things. Like her mother, Wanda, and her older siblings, she's a light sleeper and gets upset over loud noises and being woken abruptly.

Cindy is the youngest of the three children. Bob said that the first two children were manageable, but Cindy was the one that made him lose all his free time.
